notes: Replaced vpn-tunnel-up-application-reachability with vpn-up-retains-propagated-route to test a documented troubleshooting behavior.

cards.statement: VPC Reachability Analyzer sends test packets through the selected path to identify its blocking component.
cards.explanation: VPC Reachability Analyzer models network configuration instead of sending packets. A blocked result identifies a component in that configuration.
cards.misconception: Reachability Analyzer discovers blocked paths by sending test traffic through the network.

cards.statement: VPC Flow Logs can record REJECT for packets that reach a network interface after their connection has closed.
cards.explanation: A REJECT entry in VPC Flow Logs can result from packets arriving after the connection closes. The entry alone does not prove that a filtering rule is wrong.

cards.statement: For legacy access logs, an Application Load Balancer can write to an Amazon S3 bucket in a different Region.
cards.explanation: Legacy access logs use an Amazon S3 bucket in the same Region as the Application Load Balancer.
cards.misconception: Legacy Application Load Balancer log delivery accepts an S3 bucket regardless of its Region.

source.title: Enable access logs for your Application Load Balancer

cards.statement: AWS WAF can redact sampled request fields through the RedactedFields setting in its logging configuration.
cards.explanation: AWS WAF's RedactedFields setting changes traffic logs and leaves sampled requests unaffected. Use web ACL data protection to mask sampled request data.
cards.misconception: Field redaction configured for AWS WAF logs also redacts request samples.

cards.statement: With delivery permissions configured, CloudFront standard logging (v2) can send logs to a CloudWatch Logs log group.
cards.explanation: CloudFront standard logging (v2) uses CloudWatch vended logs for delivery. Set a CloudWatch Logs log group's ARN as the destination.

cards.statement: CloudFront real-time logging can use an Amazon Data Firehose delivery stream as its configured endpoint.
cards.explanation: CloudFront real-time log configurations name a stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams as their endpoint. Amazon Data Firehose can consume that stream for onward delivery.
cards.misconception: A Firehose delivery stream is a direct endpoint for CloudFront real-time access logs.

cards.statement: Amazon Athena can query compressed VPC Flow Logs in Amazon S3 after an operator creates a matching table.
cards.explanation: Amazon Athena reads GZIP-compressed VPC Flow Logs in Amazon S3 directly, so operators query them in place through the table's schema.

cards.statement: With a positive minimum TTL, CloudFront skips caching otherwise cacheable successful Cache-Control: private responses.
cards.explanation: CloudFront caches otherwise cacheable successful responses for its minimum TTL even when the origin marks them private. A positive minimum TTL overrides that directive.
cards.misconception: The origin's private cache directive overrides CloudFront's positive minimum TTL.
cards.volatilityNote: This behavior depends on minimum TTL being greater than zero, a numeric configuration condition.

cards.statement: For a virtual private gateway, AWS Site-to-Site VPN keeps propagated routes while an interrupted connection stays UP.
cards.explanation: An AWS Site-to-Site VPN interruption can leave propagated routes in place while the connection stays UP. Operators may need to disable route propagation to remove those routes.

source.title: Get started with AWS Site-to-Site VPN

cards.statement: Network Flow Monitor collects TCP performance metrics from agents that operators install on Amazon EC2 instances.
cards.explanation: The Network Flow Monitor agent gathers TCP connection statistics on the instance and sends them to the service for analysis.

cards.statement: Internet Monitor bases its performance comparisons for application clients on AWS's network-wide connectivity data.
cards.explanation: Internet Monitor builds its reference from measurements across AWS's global network, then applies it to traffic for the monitor's configured resources.

cards.statement: Network Synthetic Monitor sends its probes from on-premises hosts toward destinations inside Amazon VPC subnets.
cards.explanation: For Network Synthetic Monitor, choose a VPC subnet as the probe's AWS source and an on-premises IP address as its destination.
cards.misconception: Network Synthetic Monitor originates its probe traffic on-premises and sends it toward AWS.
